Our companies

LNJC Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies

The NJMC group sister company in Yemen.

LNJC Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies Co., Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company operating in Yemen. Its work covers active pharmaceutical ingredients, IVF products, medicines and endotoxin testing.

LNJC is a sister company within the NJMC group, with NJMC Medical Supplies Co., Ltd as the parent. LNJC operates only in Yemen and keeps its own brand.

LNJC website: landcarenj.com. Articles: blog.landcarenj.com.
